tinfoil-suit.name: Tinfoil suit
tinfoil-suit.description: A crinkling silver suit, folded with restaurant precision.

railgun-upgrade.name: Weaponry upgrade kit
railgun-upgrade.description: Use one kit to increase the fire rate of either a Railgun or an Akimbo by 10%.

upgraded-railgun.name: Upgraded Railgun
upgraded-railgun.description: A Railgun fitted with a Weaponry upgrade kit. It fires 10% faster.

upgraded-akimbo.name: Upgraded Akimbo
upgraded-akimbo.description: Dual pistols fitted with a Weaponry upgrade kit. They fire 10% faster.

combat-boots.name: Combat boots
combat-boots.description: Tall black leather boots with chrome buckles, steel toe caps, and heavy soles. Block 2 damage from each incoming combat hit.

party-boots.name: Party Boots
party-boots.description: Matilda’s tall rainbow boots, with platform soles and rows of metal studs.

eames-chair.name: Eames Chair
eames-chair.description: A walnut lounge chair with dark leather cushions from the Goblin Furniture Factory.

bertoia-chair.name: Bertoia Chair
bertoia-chair.description: A wire-frame chair from the Goblin Furniture Factory.

marshmallow-sofa.name: Marshmallow Sofa
marshmallow-sofa.description: Eighteen red upholstered discs on a slim tubular steel frame.

ovalia-chair.name: Ovalia Chair
ovalia-chair.description: A tall fiberglass egg with beige upholstery and an aluminum pedestal.

ball-chair.name: Ball chair
ball-chair.description: A sculptural white sphere with red upholstery and a chrome pedestal. Choose Ball chair from the Sit menu to settle inside.

unarmed.name: Fist
unarmed.description: Quick bare-handed strikes with very short reach.

rolling-pin.name: Rolling pin
rolling-pin.description: A reliable starter weapon with a narrow damage spread.

bowling-ball.name: Bowling ball
bowling-ball.description: A heavy close-range swing. Trades some accuracy for a bigger hit than the rolling pin.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: The hooked steel bar gives you extra reach and a solid hit.

combat-lamp.name: Combat Lamp
combat-lamp.description: A brass floor lamp with a weighted base, a glowing shade, and enough reach to keep your distance.

bayonet.name: Bayonet
bayonet.description: A precise thrust with steady damage. It can strike spectres.

battleaxe.name: Battleaxe
battleaxe.description: A slow, wide swing with a high max hit. Useful against armor.

katana.name: Katana
katana.description: A light, accurate blade. Deals smaller hits more often than the battleaxe.

railgun.name: Railgun
railgun.description: A long-range precision weapon. Its battery powers 25 shots.

akibo.name: Akimbos
akibo.description: Fast dual pistols with strong close-range DPS. Accuracy falls off sharply at distance.

new-year-rocket.name: New Year’s rocket
new-year-rocket.description: An oversized decorative rocket. Light it for ten seconds, once a minute. Open shortcuts and press J while it burns to hop about a character-height into the air.

uni.name: Uni
uni.description: Fresh sea urchin roe. Rich Table buys it for 40 coins.

sand-bucket.name: Bucket of sand
sand-bucket.description: A bucket filled with ordinary sand.

iron-armor.name: Iron torso armor
iron-armor.description: A dark gray iron breastplate and pauldrons.

iron-armor-legs.name: Iron leg armor
iron-armor-legs.description: Articulated iron plates that cover the thighs, knees, and shins.

gold-trimmed-iron-armor.name: Gold-trimmed iron armor
gold-trimmed-iron-armor.description: A dark iron breastplate edged with polished gold.

gold-trimmed-iron-armor-legs.name: Gold-trimmed iron leg armor
gold-trimmed-iron-armor-legs.description: Articulated iron leg plates edged with polished gold.

steel-chainmail.name: Steel chainmail
steel-chainmail.description: A riveted shirt of steel rings with a dark leather edging.

kevlar-vest.name: Kevlar Vest
kevlar-vest.description: A charcoal protective vest with broad shoulder straps and layered webbing.

icy-kevlar-vest.name: Icy Kevlar Vest
icy-kevlar-vest.description: A Kevlar Vest fused with an Ice Top. Pale ice plates overlap the protective fabric.

kevlar-pants.name: Kevlar Pants
kevlar-pants.description: Charcoal protective trousers with black knee pads and reinforced thighs.

icy-kevlar-pants.name: Icy Kevlar Pants
icy-kevlar-pants.description: Kevlar Pants fused with Ice Pants. Beveled ice plates protect the thighs and knees.

armor-trimming-kit.name: Armor trimming kit
armor-trimming-kit.description: Adds gold trim to one piece of iron armor.

bind-tablet.name: Bind Tablet
bind-tablet.description: Roots nearby monsters and eligible PvP opponents for ten seconds. Breaking it deals 10 damage to you.

recoil-amulet.name: Recoil amulet
recoil-amulet.description: Returns one fifth of damage taken to the attacker.

defence-amulet.name: Defence amulet
defence-amulet.description: A shield-shaped pendant. Grants +1 defence while equipped.

goblin-charm.name: Goblin Charm
goblin-charm.description: The Goblin King’s bronze seal. While equipped, it gives each missed attack one fresh accuracy roll.

invisibility-cloak.name: Invisibility cloak
invisibility-cloak.description: Hides your torso, limbs, amulet, and the cloak itself. Your head, hands, and feet remain visible. Monsters ignore you until provoked.

missile-launcher.name: Missile Launcher
missile-launcher.description: The longest reach and largest single hit. Slow to fire and uses one missile per shot.

lightsaber.name: Lightsaber
lightsaber.description: The highest sustained melee damage. A railgun battery powers ten landed hits.

light-crystal.name: Light crystal
light-crystal.description: A rare crystal dropped by monsters. The Defense Manufacturer needs one to build a lightsaber.

clock-amulet.name: Clock amulet
clock-amulet.description: A tiny clock on a chain. It keeps its own appointments.

albatross.name: Albatross
albatross.description: A whole albatross, worn on a rope around your neck. Reduces defense by 5.

backpack.name: Hiking backpack
backpack.description: A sturdy hiking pack with room for twenty sandwiches.

upgraded-backpack.name: Upgraded Hiking Backpack
upgraded-backpack.description: A reinforced hiking pack with room for twenty-five sandwiches.

hiking-backpack-upgrade-kit.name: Hiking Backpack Upgrade Kit
hiking-backpack-upgrade-kit.description: Adds room for five more sandwiches to a Hiking Backpack.

bison-hide.name: Bison hide
bison-hide.description: A heavy, shaggy hide. Yohji could make something remarkable from this.

bear-pelt.name: Bear pelt
bear-pelt.description: Thick, dark Tahoe fur. The decorative robe clothier buys it for trim.

fox-pelt.name: Fox pelt
fox-pelt.description: Russet Tahoe fur with a white underside. The decorative robe clothier buys it for trim.

fighter-yard-pass.name: Fighter Yard pass
fighter-yard-pass.description: A signed waiver and receipt for 10 coins, recorded by Tyler at the Fighter Yard.

scooter.name: Scooter
scooter.description: A compact stunt scooter with a reinforced deck. Take it out anywhere you can ride.

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.description: A single-use display of colorful fireworks from Pyromaniac Peter.

goblin-phone.name: Goblin Phone
goblin-phone.description: A clay brick. The industrialist says it makes a good notepad.

decorative-robe-top.name: Decorative robe top
decorative-robe-top.description: A pink long-sleeved robe top with rainbow trim.

cashmere-turtleneck.name: Cream cashmere turtleneck
cashmere-turtleneck.description: A soft cream cashmere sweater with a thick, folded ribbed collar.

spoon.name: Spoon
spoon.description: A spoon from Tommy. Carry it to collect an extra sack on every fifth dig at Ocean Beach.

leather-jacket.name: Leather jacket
leather-jacket.description: An open black leather jacket with a folded collar and brushed metal hardware. Increases coin earnings by 20% while equipped and stacks with the iPhone.

puffy-parka.name: Puffy Parka
puffy-parka.description: A quilted blue parka with a padded hood. Adds 1 defense when worn.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.description: A wooden barrel with iron hoops and cutouts for your arms. Adds 2 defense when worn.

goose-corp-shirt.name: Goose Corp T-shirt
goose-corp-shirt.description: A charcoal T-shirt with a white goose logo on the chest.

goose-costume.name: Goose costume
goose-costume.description: A padded white goose costume with an orange bill.

decorative-robe-bottom.name: Decorative robe bottom
decorative-robe-bottom.description: A pink robe skirt with a rainbow hem.

black-cloak-top.name: Black cloak top
black-cloak-top.description: An oversized black top with dropped shoulders, generous sleeves and a long, loose hem.

black-cloak-bottom.name: Black cloak bottom
black-cloak-bottom.description: A sweeping black skirt. Enough fabric to consider the wind a collaborator.

charcoal-suit.name: Charcoal Suit
charcoal-suit.description: A fitted charcoal jacket with matching trousers and a crisp white shirt.

black-tie.name: Black Tie
black-tie.description: A black silk tie with a neatly dimpled knot.

white-scarf.name: White scarf
white-scarf.description: A soft white scarf with a loose wrap and fringed ends.

blue-jeans.name: Blue jeans
blue-jeans.description: Indigo denim with faded knees, gold stitching, and turned cuffs.

silk-kimono.name: Silk kimono
silk-kimono.description: A plum silk kimono with wide sleeves, an obi sash, and embroidered blossoms.

techwear-top.name: Techwear Top
techwear-top.description: A close-cut graphite jacket with an offset zipper, alloy chest fittings, and adjustable cuffs.

techwear-bottoms.name: Techwear Cargo Pants
techwear-bottoms.description: Loose cargo trousers with gusseted pockets, brushed metal clasps, and cinch straps.

yellow-top.name: Bride's top
yellow-top.description: A fitted golden-yellow zip jacket with black racing stripes.

yellow-pants.name: Bride's pants
yellow-pants.description: Slim yellow trousers with a black stripe down each leg.

goblin-helmet.name: Goblin helmet
goblin-helmet.description: A goblin guard's hammered helmet. Blocks up to 2 damage per incoming combat hit.

upgraded-goblin-helmet.name: Reinforced goblin helmet
upgraded-goblin-helmet.description: A goblin helmet reinforced with a riveted band. Blocks up to 3 damage per incoming combat hit.

goblin-helmet-upgrade-kit.name: Goblin helmet upgrade kit
goblin-helmet-upgrade-kit.description: Rivets and a reinforced band. Use it from the inventory to improve a goblin helmet.

bush-hat.name: Bush hat
bush-hat.description: A huge round crown of leaves. Adds 1 defense when worn.

bush-top.name: Bush top
bush-top.description: A round bush big enough to hide your whole torso. Adds 1 defense when worn.

bush-legs.name: Bush legs
bush-legs.description: Two round clumps of foliage, one for each leg. Adds 1 defense when worn.

downtown-tablet.name: Downtown Teleport
downtown-tablet.description: A small purple tablet. Break it to return to downtown San Francisco.

tahoe-tablet.name: Tahoe Teleport
tahoe-tablet.description: A snowy sigil in purple stone. Break it to appear beside the Tahoe gondola.

berkeley-tablet.name: Berkeley Teleport
berkeley-tablet.description: A purple teleport tablet stamped with the Berkeley institute’s campanile.

ice-top.name: Ice top
ice-top.description: A crystalline cuirass. While equipped, blocks up to 5 damage per incoming combat hit.

ice-pants.name: Ice pants
ice-pants.description: Frosted greaves. While equipped, block up to 5 damage per incoming combat hit.

sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.description: A sandwich. Store it in your food bag and eat it to recover hitpoints.

peptides.name: Peptides
peptides.description: A tiny vial with a very large social network. Ray accepts these at the Freemasons’ Guild.

coins.name: Coins
coins.description: Loose coins, awaiting a less theoretical owner.

goose-membership-card.name: Goose Corp membership card
goose-membership-card.description: A very official-looking card. The fine print seems to be turning to dust.

stetson-hat.name: Stetson
stetson-hat.description: A sand-dusted cowboy hat. The shark was keeping it under its hat.

pirate-hat.name: Pirate's hat
pirate-hat.description: A salt-stained tricorn. The previous owner had an unusually flexible interpretation of navigation.

raptor.name: Velociraptor remains
raptor.description: The emergency recovery protocol is now considerably less mobile.

kraken.name: Kraken spoils
kraken.description: The spoils of an extremely unwise maritime expedition.
